The check-charly-mise image: the REAL omarchy box plus the charly-mise-consumer
candy, whose mise.toml auto-triggers the mise builder (detection path). The
builder stage installs charly via mise (GitHub backend) and the artifacts
(installs + shims + config) land in the image.

## Composition

This box composes:

- `charly-mise-consumer`
